description: UniFi access point SNMP metrics from Prometheus. CPU, memory, load and device SNMP-message panels are omitted because the AP scrape does not currently return those metrics.

targets.expr: up{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`} * on(instance) group_left(sysName) (sysName{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`} or on(instance) up{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`}) * on(instance) group_left(unifiApSystemModel) (unifiApSystemModel{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`} or on(instance) up{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`}) * on(instance) group_left(unifiApSystemVersion) (unifiApSystemVersion{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`} or on(instance) up{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`}) * on(instance) group_left(sysDescr) (sysDescr{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`} or on(instance) up{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`}) * on(instance) group_left(sysContact) (sysContact{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`} or on(instance) up{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`}) * on(instance) group_left(sysLocation) (sysLocation{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`} or on(instance) up{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`})

sum by (instance, unifiVapName, unifiVapIndex, unifiVapEssId, metric) (label_replace(unifiVapChannel{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`,unifiVapName=~`${vap:regex}`}, "metric", "Channel", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(unifiVapExtChannel{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`,unifiVapName=~`${vap:regex}`}, "metric", "Extended channel", "__name__", ".*") or label_replace(unifiVapTxPower{job="unifi_ap_snmp",instance=~`${ap:regex}`,unifiVapName=~`${vap:regex}`}, "metric", "Tx power (dBm)", "__name__", ".*"))

title: UniFi AP Dashboard
